SAY: I can offer strict quiet hours and door-closing for your early mornings, but I need flexibility for my social energy and late-night schedule.

CNF:[slp:conflict(6am wake vs late nights), gwk:conflict(weekly guests vs quiet need)]
FLX:[slp:offer(Strict quiet hours after 10pm and before 7am)|condition(You respect my late-night activity), gwk:offer(Door-closing policy and reduced noise)|condition(You allow weekly small gatherings)]
